IRON YARD — one-shot PUBLIC update request (11 November 2026)
The owner requested continued production improvement on the existing PUBLIC
IRON YARD Roblox-shooter experience, without private or alpha staging.

Changes authorized for this exact main commit after GREEN Rojo CI:
- AR-24 support hand follows its independently animated Blender PBR magazine
- B-8 shotgun support hand tracks the loading shell and returns to the pump;
  restrained reload pose on ECO devices without an optional visible shell
- smooth server-reload cancellation, preserve hand interpolation on PBR LOD swaps
- regression tests and Android Studio visual acceptance instructions

No combat server change or proprietary materials; no credentials in repository.
The owner/visibility/place checks and exact-SHA CI release gate are unchanged.
